data.jd_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking a highly driven self\-starter with exceptional program\-level delivery experience to join Anaplan in UAE. This is a rare, high\-impact opportunity to lay the groundwork and shape the success of our most strategic enterprise customers across the Middle East.
 



 At Anaplan, we are redefining how businesses plan and make decisions through our cutting\-edge Connected Planning platform, powered by our unique deterministic calculation engine and advanced AI capabilities. In this role, you will be at the forefront of this transformation.
 



 You will bring a proven track record of leading complex, high\-stakes implementations—ideally within Supply Chain, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), or Workforce Planning. Thriving at the intersection of delivery and strategic advisory, you will scope, negotiate, manage escalations, and serve as an indispensable partner to both customer and internal stakeholders. From C\-level executives to daily end\-users, you will excel at influencing decisions and cementing your status as a trusted advisor.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership position tailor\-made for a delivery expert who can seamlessly orchestrate multiple enterprise programs, ensure strict adherence to budget and scope, and expertly pivot to recover projects that have drifted off track.
 



**Your Impact (What You’ll Do)** 



* **Drive Delivery Excellence:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end Anaplan deployments alongside internal teams and external partners, establishing robust governance, ensuring precise scoping, and proactively uncovering hidden assumptions.
* **Be the Strategic Anchor:** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery, building alignment with customer stakeholders ranging from operational leads up to the C\-suite.
* **Master Complex Programs:** 
 Navigate intricate, multi\-faceted programs, ensuring flawless delivery while expertly balancing scope, risk, budget, and resourcing.
* **Accelerate Decision\-Making:** 
 Anticipate bottlenecks and drive critical project decisions across design, testing, timelines, and organizational change management.
* **Build Consensus:** 
 Leverage top\-tier negotiation skills to resolve conflicts, maintain project momentum, and unite diverse teams behind a shared goal.
* **Champion Excellence:** 
 Advocate for and implement the "Anaplan Way" methodology, ensuring the delivery of scalable, highly intuitive, and user\-friendly solutions.
* **Deliver Transparency:** 
 Provide clear, actionable reporting on project status and overall portfolio health to both internal leadership and external stakeholders.



**Your DNA (What You Bring)** 



* **Enterprise Expertise:** 
 Demonstrable history of exemplary program or project management across complex, large\-scale enterprise initiatives.
* **Agile Mastery:** 
 Deep, hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery methodologies—this is essential for driving our fast\-paced implementations.
* **Turnaround Architect:** 
 Proven ability to recover and realign complex projects led by partners or vendors. We are looking for a track record of delivering—and rescuing—large\-scale projects under tight timelines and budgets.
* **Executive Influence:** 
 Exceptional customer engagement and communication skills, characterized by the ability to negotiate, influence senior leadership, and confidently act as a trusted strategic advisor.
* **Domain Knowledge (Bonus):** 
 While not strictly essential, domain expertise in Supply Chain, FP\&A, or Workforce Planning will highly differentiate your application.



**Why Join Us?** 
 As the first Principal Solution Implementation Manager in the region, you won't just be managing projects; you will be building a legacy. You'll work with industry\-defining AI and planning technology, partner with the world's leading brands, and have a tangible impact on how global enterprises operate.
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. data.jd_text:
**Your mission**
 We are seeking an experienced and forward\-thinking Project Director to lead the delivery of some of the most ambitious and innovative Spatial Experience projects in the region and beyond. This is not a traditional project management role \- it is a senior leadership position for someone who can drive complex turnkey projects with confidence, precision, and commercial clarity.
   

  

 You will take ownership of a portfolio of high\-profile international projects across museums, visitor attractions, cultural destinations, and large\-scale experiential installations. From tender strategy and planning through execution and close\-out, you will shape delivery standards, elevate performance, and ensure exceptional outcomes for both clients and stakeholders.
   

  

 Operational excellence is essential, but what sets this role apart is leadership. We are looking for a strategic decision\-maker and delivery\-driven leader who can build strong teams, manage complexity at scale, and consistently raise the bar in a fast\-paced, high\-expectation environment.
   

  

 Key responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Lead a portfolio of complex international projects from tender stage through planning, execution, delivery, and close\-out, ensuring full project organization and control.
* Oversee the development of the master project schedule and ensure effective implementation across all phases.
* Monitor project performance with a strong focus on quality, deadlines, and cost control.
* Conduct project reviews and produce detailed reporting for internal and external stakeholders.
* Lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously, from pre\-construction through completion.
* Ensure strict adherence to ethics, compliance, and internal governance requirements at all times.
* Actively participate in the tender process, including design coordination, submission preparation, and tender review.
* Provide leadership in risk assessment, contract negotiations, fee structures, and pricing decisions.
* Tender, negotiate, and award supplier and subcontractor contracts.
* Collaborate with Crew Management on resource planning for assigned projects using EasyJob software.
* Coordinate with QHSE teams on\-site to ensure delivery in line with HSE and QAQC standards and compliance requirements.
* Build and maintain strong long\-term client relationships and actively expand the client network.
* Identify and secure growth opportunities, initiating and supporting new project development.
* Support Project Managers and project teams, proactively resolving escalated issues and ensuring smooth project delivery.


**Your profile**
* Proven experience in project management and delivery of turnkey projects (scenic, fit\-out, AVL) such as museums, visitor experience centers, EXPO pavilions, and other permanent or semi\-permanent installations within the entertainment and cultural sector.
* Degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Audiovisual Engineering, or a related field is highly desirable.
* Solid technical understanding of Audio, Video, Lighting systems, and control technologies, with experience in large\-scale installations (preferred).
* Demonstrated ability to develop, manage, and control large\-scale project budgets.
* Strong industry network within the UAE and KSA is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage.

* The opportunity to work in an international and multi\-cultural team with collaboration across our offices in the Middle East and Europe.
* Collaborative and motivated working environment.
* Trusting and partnership\-based cooperation across all units.
* An innovative and growth\-oriented company with a matrix organizational structure and an open corporate culture.


**About Us**
 BeWunder is your turnkey partner specializing in Event Production and Spatial Experiences.
   

  

 We create inspiring and unforgettable experiences for our clients and their guests. Our renowned and highly\-skilled team of industry experts in both live events and permanent construction is well\-versed in bridging the gap between vision and reality. We design, deliver and service complex, challenging, and large\-scale projects in the field of museums and exhibitions, EXPO and brand pavilions, visitor and experience centers, digital art spaces, live events \- both corporate and sporting, as well as conferences and multimedia shows.
   

  

 Our passion lies in producing multisensory and immersive experiences, a perfect blend of new technologies and content, staged lighting and interactive elements.
   

  

 With our international track record in Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we are perfectly positioned to realize exceptional projects for our clients around the globe, from initial concept design through to final installation and beyond!

data.jd_text:
**Senior Technical Project Manager – Thermal Generation** 




**Project Development and New Technologies, AMEA** 









**Objective** 




  





 The Senior Technical Project Manager (STPM) \- Thermal Generation Projects and New Technologies leads the technical development of large power projects and supports the decarbonization initiatives of the thermal generation fleet in Asia, Middle East and Africa region (AMEA). The STPM will be responsible for supporting the extensions of PPAs of existing thermal assets, development of greenfield thermal power projects (OCGT and CCGT), asset decarbonization initiatives and projects, assessment of new technologies in collaboration with the ENGIE Group Research and Innovation ecosystem, and management of third party engineering consultants. S/he may from time to time also be involved in Hydrogen and Battery Energy Storage projects.
 



  





**Job responsibility** 




  





**Technical Project Management (Thermal Generation Greenfield Projects and Extensions)** 



* Provides the technical definition of the project and manages the selection of technologies, specifications, configuration, performance analysis, availability, outages, and evaluation of innovative technology solutions.
* Assure safety operability and maintainability is careful considered in new plant designs.
* Manages/Reviews all project related studies during bidding/development phase till hand\-over to execution: pre\-feasibility studies (if any), feasibility studies (if any), ESIA studies…
* Leads the technical development and documentation of the contractual agreements during development/bidding and negotiation stage: EPC, PPA, electricity connection agreement, LTPRA, LTSA, O\&M Contracts etc...
* Contributes to the technical qualification of EPC Contractors
* Manages the main equipment supplier’s selection with the EPC contractor.
* Animates and manages several technical review meetings with the EPC contractor to optimize the plant design.
* Manages the technical mark up and proposed deviations (if any) of bidding documents.
* In narrow coordination with Procurement proposes and defines technical\-commercial optimizations with the contractor(s).
* In narrow coordination with the PMO team prepares the technical related part of the project execution and operation.
* In narrow coordination with the PMO team prepares all Construction technical and O\&M related documents for the proposal/bid: EPC Term sheet and/or EPC Contract, O\&M Term Sheet and/or contract, OM organization chart, including Guarantees and testing procedures, O\&M philosophy...
* Based on technical assumptions develop the CAPEX and OPEX cost for the project.
* Liaises with the lenders and the Lender's Engineer for the establishment of their due diligence report prior to Financial Close.
* Ensures detail coordination with all internal stakeholders: BD, Construction, Operation, Legal, Finance and Procurement teams
* Contributes to the internal approval process (for Bid submission including Construction, Technical and O\&M) until Financial Close. Ensures adequate internal reviews.
* Support the negotiations with the contractors.
* Punctually provides support to construction and operation activities.
* Prepares the technical hand\-over for execution stage.
* Ensures experience capitalization and REX integration.



  





**New Technologies and Decarbonisation Lead** 



* Acts as a SPOC for the ENGIE Group Research \& Innovation (R\&I) programmes and community
* Leads on implementation of decarbonisation initiatives or projects and supports other team members with decarbonisation topics
* Maintains a technology watch
* Fosters the innovation culture by coordinating and animating knowledge sharing



**Lead on Engagement of Third\-Party Engineering Consultants** 



* Keeps a market watch on engineering consultants (technical advisors)
* Leads the qualification, tendering, selection and management of technical consultants: Bid Technical Advisor, Owners’ Engineer, Lenders’ Technical Advisors, ESIA Consultant… on various AMEA projects



**Qualification/Experience** 



* Engineering degree, with a minimum of 15 years of experience.
* Experience in projects technical development.
* Experience in bid preparation.
* Experience in thermal power generation projects (preferably CCGT).
* Excellent capability in interpreting and optimising power plant design and performance; experience using Thermoflow software is a plus.
* Good understanding of thermal generation decarbonisation technologies, including renewable gases, CCUS…
* Experience in engaging and working with engineering consulting firms.
* Experience in preparing and negotiating contractual documents: WPA, PPA, PWPA, EPC, EPCM, subcontractors, O\&M, LTSA, LTPRA, consultants’ contracts...
* Experienced in interfacing with BD team, legal team, finance team, construction team, operation team.
* Experience in managing and coordinating research and innovation programmes will be an advantage.
* Experience in desalination will be an advantage.
* Experience within ENGIE Group will be an advantage.



**Character and Skills** 



* Pro\-active, autonomous, taking ownership of issues and drive to resolve them
* Organized and rigorous
* Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills
* Able to collaborate effectively with multiple stakeholders from different backgrounds
* Languages: fluent English. Arab or French will be an advantage.



  





  





 ENGIE group is a global reference in low\-carbon energy and services. Together with our 96,000 employees, our customers, partners and stakeholders, we are committed to accelerate the transition towards a carbon\-neutral world, through reduced energy consumption and more environmentally friendly solutions. Inspired by our purpose (“raison d’être”), we reconcile economic performance with a positive impact on people and the planet, building on our key businesses (gas, renewable energy, services) to offer competitive solutions to our customers.
 



 ENGIE’s Business Unit for the Asia Middle East and Africa (AMEA) region is headquartered in Dubai. The region has activities in large scale power generation, water desalination, district cooling, energy solutions and renewables including green hydrogen, wind and solar. We act throughout the value chain: strategy, design, engineering, energy\-efficient asset construction, digital platforms, operations management, financing syndication and outcome assurance. And, by using globally leading technologies, we create innovative energy and smart solutions that help to make the world a better place.

**About ARADA** 




 ARADA is one of the UAE's leading master developers, dedicated to creating communities that inspire, enrich, and engage. Since its launch in 2017, ARADA has delivered award\-winning residential, retail, hospitality, education, and wellness destinations across the UAE. Driven by innovation, quality, and customer experience, ARADA is committed to building vibrant communities that enhance the lives of residents, visitors, and businesses alike.
 



 As we continue our growth journey, we are looking for an experienced and results\-driven
 **Senior Project Manager** 
 to join our Development team in Dubai. This role is instrumental in delivering high\-profile mixed\-use, residential, hospitality, retail, and commercial developments, ensuring projects are executed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 The Senior Project Manager will lead the end\-to\-end execution of development projects from design development through procurement, construction, handover, and close\-out. Working closely with internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and authorities, the successful candidate will ensure the successful delivery of projects aligned with ARADA's strategic objectives, quality expectations, and commercial goals.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Project Leadership
 


* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and successful delivery of assigned development projects.
* Manage projects through all development phases including design, authority approvals, procurement, construction, testing \& commissioning, handover, and defects liability period.
* Develop and maintain detailed project execution plans, schedules, budgets, and risk registers.
* Monitor project performance against agreed milestones and implement corrective actions where required.



 Design \& Development Management
 


* Coordinate with the Design Management team to ensure designs meet project objectives, regulatory requirements, cost targets, and construction feasibility.
* Review consultant deliverables to ensure quality, completeness, and alignment with project briefs.
* Drive value engineering initiatives while maintaining design intent and customer experience.



 Construction Management
 


* Oversee contractors, consultants, and project management consultants throughout project execution.
* Monitor construction progress, quality, health \& safety, and compliance with project specifications.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings to ensure timely issue resolution.
* Ensure projects achieve practical completion and handover in accordance with company standards.



 Commercial \& Financial Management
 


* Work closely with Commercial and Procurement teams to monitor project budgets and cost performance.
* Review variation orders, claims, payment applications, and commercial risks.
* Support contract administration and ensure contractual obligations are fulfilled.



 Stakeholder Management
 


* Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders across Development, Design, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Facilities Management.
* Coordinate with government authorities and utility providers to obtain required approvals and permits.
* Build strong relationships with consultants, contractors, and external partners.



 Risk \& Governance
 


* Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Ensure compliance with company governance, development processes, quality standards, and HSE requirements.
* Prepare executive reports and project updates for senior management.



 Continuous Improvement
 


* Drive lessons learned initiatives and implement best practices across projects.
* Promote innovation, sustainability, and efficient project delivery methodologies.
* Mentor and support junior project managers and engineers where required.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related discipline.

 **10–15 years**

data.jd_text:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The People Team at Agoda is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent from across the globe. We work to create an inclusive, high\-performing, and engaging environment where employees can grow, contribute meaningfully, and do their best work. Through a strong focus on people experience, service quality, and business partnership, we help Agoda scale while preserving what makes our culture distinctive.
   

  

 Within the People Team, the
 **People Experience and Services** 
 function is responsible for designing and delivering critical people experiences, services, and operating foundations that support employees and managers across the employee lifecycle. This includes enabling smooth onboarding and mobility experiences, delivering effective workplace and office services, and ensuring employees have access to timely, trusted, and high\-quality support when they need it.
   

  

 At the center of this model sits
 **People Services \& Help Desk** 
 — Agoda’s front door for People support — supported by specialist service teams such as
 **People Relations Services** 
 . Together, these teams play a critical role in how employees and managers experience the People function day to day: through clear guidance, responsive support, effective issue resolution, and trusted handling of sensitive people matters.
   

  

**Opportunity**
 We are looking for an
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk** 
 to lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People service delivery model across
 **People Help Desk / Tier 1 support** 
 ,
 **Tier 0 / self\-service foundations** 
 , and
 **Global People Relations Services** 
 .
   

  

 This is a key leadership role within People Experience and Services, responsible for shaping how employees and managers access support across a wide range of People topics — from day\-to\-day HR questions and lifecycle support to more complex and sensitive employee matters requiring specialist intervention.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the teams responsible for:
   

  

* People Help Desk / Tier 1 services
* Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge foundations
* Global People Relations Services, including case governance and specialist support for complex employee relations matters


 You will own the effectiveness of Agoda’s People support model from the employee and manager perspective, ensuring it is clear, trusted, scalable, and increasingly insight\-driven. This includes strengthening service standards, improving routing and handoffs across teams, enabling greater self\-service, and ensuring sensitive employee matters are handled with appropriate quality, consistency, and governance.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a leader who combines strong service delivery and operational leadership with sound judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to build a modern, scalable People support model in a global, fast\-moving organization.
   

  

 This position is based in
 **Bangkok** 
 . Agoda provides relocation support for successful candidates who are not currently located in Bangkok. Please note that we are
 **not open to remote work** 
 or the possibility of being based in other locations.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Lead Agoda’s People Services front door and employee support model**
* Lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People Services model across Tier 1 Help Desk support, Tier 0 self\-service, and the interface into specialist support teams.
* Define and evolve how employees and managers access support across People topics, ensuring a clear, seamless, and trusted experience.
* Establish strong service principles, operating rhythms, and leadership across the teams responsible for day\-to\-day People support and complex employee issue resolution.
* Ensure Agoda’s People support model scales effectively with organizational growth, complexity, and global reach.


**Lead the People Services \& Help Desk team**
* Lead, manage, and develop the People Services \& Help Desk team to deliver high\-quality, consistent, and empathetic Tier 1 support across core HR topics such as policies, processes, employee data, benefits, onboarding, leaves, mobility, and general employee lifecycle support.
* Set service standards, KPIs, quality expectations, and operating controls to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant case handling.
* Build a strong service culture with clear accountability for employee experience, right\-first\-time resolution, responsiveness, and professionalism.
* Oversee workforce planning, capacity management, and prioritization across service demand, seasonal peaks, and new People initiatives.


**Lead Global People Relations Services**
* Lead the Global People Relations Services team, ensuring high\-quality and well\-governed support across complex employee matters such as performance concerns, misconduct, grievances, investigations, disciplinary actions, involuntary exits, and employee matters arising from organizational change.
* Ensure clear service ownership, escalation pathways, and governance across People Relations case handling.
* Partner closely with HR Business Partners, Legal, Compliance, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure people relations matters are handled fairly, consistently, pragmatically, and in line with internal policies and local legal requirements.
* Drive high standards in case management, documentation, risk identification, and decision quality across the People Relations team.
* Use case trends and themes to inform improvements in manager guidance, policy design, service processes, and broader practices.


**Own the operating interfaces across Tier 1, People Relations, and specialist teams**
* Serve as the senior operational owner for how work flows between Help Desk / Tier 1, People Relations Services, and other Tier 2 / specialist teams across the People organization.
* Define and continuously improve routing logic, escalation models, intake criteria, handoffs, service ownership, and resolution pathways.
* Ensure employees and managers experience a joined\-up service model even when multiple People teams are involved.
* Clarify roles and interfaces across Help Desk, People Relations, Payroll, Rewards, Mobility, People Partners, CoEs, and other specialist teams.


**Build Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge management foundations**
* Develop and execute Agoda’s roadmap for Tier 0 / self\-service, moving the organization toward more proactive, intuitive, and self\-directed resolution of common People queries.
* Own and strengthen the People knowledge ecosystem, including FAQs, help content, decision trees, agent guidance, and employee\-facing support materials.
* Partner with policy owners and People SMEs to simplify complex topics into clear, scalable, and user\-friendly content.
* Drive case deflection, knowledge reuse, content governance, and self\-service adoption through disciplined measurement and continuous improvement.


**Enable digital, conversational, and AI\-supported service delivery**
* Partner with Product, Tech, Systems, and Data teams to improve People support platforms, workflows, and user journeys across self\-service and case management.
* Identify and help shape practical use cases for conversational and agentic AI within People Services, ensuring they enhance employee experience and complement human support.
* Provide leadership input into the design, testing, rollout, and continuous refinement of AI\-enabled and digital service solutions.
* Ensure appropriate controls, privacy, escalation paths, and trust mechanisms are in place for all digital and AI\-supported support channels.


**Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement**
* Monitor and improve key service performance metrics across Help Desk and People Relations Services, such as case volume, first contact resolution, time to resolution, service quality, customer satisfaction, escalation rates, re\-open rates, and self\-service deflection.
* Lead ongoing improvements in workflows, playbooks, standard responses, training, quality assurance, and reporting.
* Partner with People Service Excellence and other stakeholders to simplify processes, remove friction, and improve end\-to\-end employee and manager experiences.
* Ensure effective controls, compliance, documentation standards, and data privacy practices are embedded across service operations.


**Lead through insight, stakeholder partnership, and change**
* Act as the senior People Services contact for service performance, priorities, risks, and transformation opportunities.
* Provide regular insight and reporting to People leaders on service trends, root causes, organizational pain points, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with Communications and relevant People teams to coordinate messaging around policy changes, process updates, and new tools or services.
* Support broader People transformation by bringing an employee\-service lens to operating model design, simplification, and capability building across the function.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, Operations, Law, Psychology, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
* Typically, 10\+ years of relevant experience across HR shared services, employee services, People operations, employee relations, HRBP, service delivery, or related functions, including significant leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers and/or multiple service teams in a complex, matrixed, and fast\-paced environment.
* Strong experience running a service or support function with clear accountability for quality, responsiveness, service design, and stakeholder experience.
* Strong understanding of multi\-tier service delivery models, including Tier 0 / self\-service, Tier 1 support, and specialist / Tier 2 case management.
* Meaningful exposure to employee relations or complex people issue resolution, with sound judgment on sensitive matters and a strong appreciation for governance, risk, and consistency.
* Strong skills in service design, operating model improvement, process improvement, and cross\-functional workflow design.
* Experience with HR technology platforms and service tools such as HRIS, case management systems, knowledge bases, and digital support tools.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and analytics to monitor performance, identify themes and root causes, and drive prioritization and decision\-making.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence across leaders, specialist teams, and cross\-functional partners.
* Strong people leadership capability, including coaching leaders and managers, building team capability, and creating a high\-performance, service\-oriented culture.
* Comfort operating in a global, evolving, and ambiguous environment, with a strong bias for execution, improvement, and scale.


**It’s great if you also have**
* Experience in a global or regional HR shared services / People services environment.
* Experience leading both broad employee support teams and specialist employee relations or case management teams.
* Experience in knowledge management, service content strategy, and self\-service adoption.
* Hands\-on exposure to conversational AI, chatbots, virtual assistants, or workflow automation in HR or customer support environments.
* Experience improving employee experience through service redesign, process simplification, or digital product thinking.
* Experience in a high\-growth tech, internet, or digital business.
* Familiarity with global organizations operating across multiple countries, cultures, and regulatory environments.


**Why this role matters**
 This role is a unique opportunity to shape how Agoda employees and managers experience People support at scale. From everyday HR queries to more complex and sensitive employee matters, the teams in this scope play an important role in making sure our people feel supported, informed, and able to navigate key moments in their Agoda journey with confidence.
   

  

 As
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk** 
 , you will help build a more connected, scalable, and future\-ready support model, improving service quality, strengthening self\-service, and ensuring complex cases are handled with care and consistency. Your work will directly influence employee experience, manager effectiveness, and how the People function continues to evolve as Agoda grows globally.
   

  

 \#PeopleServices \#HRSharedServices \#EmployeeRelations \#Bangkok \#Singapore \#Bengaluru \#Hyderabad \#NewDelhi \#Gurugram \#Noida \#Mumbai \#Pune \#Chennai \#Jakarta \#Manila \#KualaLumpur \#HoChiMinhCity \#Hanoi \#HongKong \#Taipei \#Seoul \#Dubai \#Istanbul

 For our business, for clients, and for you
   

  

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**
**About Apex:**
 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. The role requires a strong combination of operational leadership, client delivery excellence, commercial awareness and transformation capability.
   

  

**Technical Tasks:**
* Oversee and lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the fund accounting service for close\-ended funds, ensuring accuracy and compliance with fund governing documents and regulatory guidance.
* Provide leadership on complex client and operational matters requiring senior judgment.
* Ensure full adherence to the prevailing control environment.
* Be a leading participant in the continuous development of our operating processes and procedures.
* Be an escalation point for technical queries from all stakeholders in your region.
* Oversee the timely completion of all audits.
* Ensure local teams’ adherence to regulatory compliance and underlying reporting.


**Tasks/Responsibilities:**
* Translate strategy into an operational plan for delivery of service and provide guidance to ensure consistent organisational leadership and day\-to\-day business running.
* Ensure effective implementation of the operating model with ownership for both onshore and offshore components, work closely with other regional functional leads across operations and wider CRM and Product teams.
* Implement agreed best practices while striving for continuous improvement.
* Develop and foster client relationships and ensure we exceed their expectations and are their provider of choice.
* Team collaboration across multiple jurisdictions globally including global operations centres and ensure that client deliverables are being met.
* Monitoring of actual versus target hours per fund/client and action as required. Ensure there is a continuous drive to improve our efficiency.
* Contribute to the achievement of regional financial and operational performance targets.
* Ensure effective \& timely resolutions to any errors identified.
* KPI’s to be consistently above the specified target for each team in your region (accuracy, timeliness, and delivery)
* Team capacity planning and full awareness of incoming pipeline, including ownership of hire requests.
* People management with a focus on development, motivation, and succession planning/talent management.
* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.
* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.
* Develop, maintain and role model a culture that is open to change and innovation, and supports collaboration, respect, and accountability.
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends.


**Skills Required:**
* Bachelor or Master level degree.
* Strong accountancy knowledge, a professional designation such as CA, CPAA, or ACCA etc., would be an asset.
* Solid experience working with private markets / closed\-ended fund structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Extensive practical experience, 15\+ years of fund accounting work experience.
* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.
* Extensive experience working with external clients and an ability to inspire confidence.
* Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written).
* Motivated, bright, and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines \& targets.
* Attention to detail and ability to work on multiple projects.
* A team player who is genuinely motivated by improving our service and teams.
* An ability to think critically and objectively while having strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
* Advanced level MS Excel, proficient with MS Word, MS PowerPoint.
* A detailed understanding of the various fund types covered by this role (Private Equity, Real Estate, Credit \& Venture Capital).


**What you will get in return:**
* A unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business and to lead teams across different locations.
* A friendly, co\-operative, and supportive environment.
* Exposure to many different fund types and a wide variety of clients.
* An opportunity to make an impact in a leading product for Apex.
* Training and development opportunities.

data.jd_text:
Due to the continuing success and growth of our AESG team, a fantastic opportunity has opened up at our award\-winning Specialist Consultancy, Engineering and Advisory Firm.
   

  

 We are headquartered in London, Riyadh, Singapore and Dubai, Cape Town, Cairo \& Sydney working throughout the Middle East, Europe and Asia. Our areas of expertise are represented in four core verticals: Building Engineering, Planning and Infrastructure, Strategy and Advisory and Commissioning, Handover and Asset Management.
   

  

 We pride ourselves in being leaders in the industry in each of the services that we offer. We have one of the largest dedicated team with decades of cumulative experience in sustainable design, fire and life safety, cost management, façade engineering, commissioning, building performance, waste management, environmental consultancy, carbon management and acoustics.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 AESG is seeking an experienced BIM Manager with deep expertise in data center and mission critical facility design to join our Mission Critical department. Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead BIM implementation, coordination, and delivery across diverse data center projects throughout the EMEA region, as well as occasional building services projects including hotels, offices, and commercial developments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in BIM processes and digital design delivery with proven experience managing complex multidisciplinary coordination for hyperscale data center operators. This role requires hands\-on involvement in model production, team supervision, and technical delivery, while acting as the Lead Appointed Party under ISO 19650 for assigned projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as Lead Appointed Party for BIM delivery in accordance with ISO 19650, with formal authority to accept, reject, or delay information deliveries that do not meet agreed standards and client Exchange Information Requirements (EIR)
* Develop and maintain project\-level BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), Master Information Delivery Plans (MIDP), and review/approve Task Information Delivery Plans (TIDP) submitted by design disciplines
* Establish and manage Common Data Environment (CDE) structures using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, including project setup, access control, folder structures, workflow configuration, status codes, and information containers (Work in Progress, Shared, Published, Archive)
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, chairing clash detection reviews, coordination meetings, and issue resolution sessions with architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, and specialist disciplines
* Enforce BIM standards, protocols, and quality control procedures, ensuring compliance with ISO 19650, BSRIA BG6 guidance for MEP, hyperscaler\-specific requirements and client specifications
* Supervise and mentor project BIM teams on Revit best practices, family creation, parametric modeling, and workflow optimization, while maintaining hands\-on involvement in complex modeling tasks
* Manage COBie\-compliant asset data structuring and delivery for facilities management handover, supporting construction phase information delivery and digital twin integration
* Prepare and deliver BIM coordination reports, clash reports, design validation summaries, model quality audits, and lessons learned documentation
* Support business development through BIM capability presentations, technical demonstrations, and proposal preparation
* Identify and escalate BIM delivery risks early, implementing structured risk management procedures


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years progressive experience as BIM Manager, BIM Coordinator, or senior BIM role with significant focus on data center and mission critical facilities
* Proven application of ISO 19650 on live projects, including experience as Lead Appointed Party or within ISO 19650\-compliant frameworks, with working knowledge of EIR, BEP, MIDP, TIDP documentation
* Demonstrated expertise delivering projects for hyperscale operators (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) with deep understanding of their Revit templates, family libraries, naming conventions, and coordination workflows
* Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Architecture, Structure, MEP) including parametric modeling, family creation, phasing, worksets, design options, view templates, and advanced scheduling, with hands\-on modeling experience
* Expert\-level experience with Common Data Environments (CDE) including Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360 administration, and strong expertise in Navisworks for 3D coordination, clash detection, and 4D sequencing
* Practical experience with COBie asset data structuring and familiarity with BSRIA BG6 Building Services BIM guidance
* Proven track record delivering data center projects across design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and EPC frameworks, coordinating mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, civil, and specialist disciplines (fire protection, security, telecom)
* Significant experience with projects in GCC and broader EMEA region, with understanding of regional BIM maturity levels, local codes, and stakeholder dynamics
* Strong technical background in building services engineering with ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, understand construction methods, building systems, and MEP coordination requirements
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to explain technical BIM concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and lead coordination meetings
* Proactive, structured approach with demonstrated ability to manage delivery risk and hold authority to challenge non\-compliant information
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline; professional certifications (Autodesk Certified Professional, buildingSMART certifications) preferred


**Desired Skills \& Attributes**
* Advanced BIM tools: Dynamo for Revit automation, Solibri for model checking, Bluebeam for PDF coordination, digital twin platforms for operational handover
* Point cloud processing and scan\-to\-BIM workflows for existing facility documentation
* Computational design and visual scripting (Dynamo, Grasshopper) for design automation
* Sustainable design coordination experience (LEED, BREEAM, ESTIDAMA) and energy modeling integration (IES VE, IES Apache, DesignBuilder)
* Data center\-specific BIM knowledge: hot/cold aisle modeling, cable tray routing for high\-density power, precision cooling coordination, raised floor systems, structured cabling infrastructure
* Federated model coordination strategies, including coordination sequencing, trade\-specific clash priorities, and progressive coordination approaches
* 4D scheduling integration (Navisworks Timeliner, Synchro) for construction sequencing visualization
* Understanding of data center monitoring systems (DCIM, EPMS, BMS) and BIM coordination with operational systems
* Experience supporting construction phase information delivery and commissioning coordination
* Mentoring capabilities with experience guiding junior BIM coordinators and modelers
* Project management skills including planning, resource allocation, and progress tracking
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in fast\-paced environments while maintaining quality standards


**What We Offer**
* Clear career progression with increasing leadership responsibilities as the department and BIM maturity expand
* Exposure to diverse mission critical projects across EMEA, working with leading hyperscaler operators and regional data center developers
* Direct reporting to Head of Mission Critical with significant autonomy to shape BIM processes, standards, and digital design delivery
* Hands\-on involvement with cutting\-edge data center projects including campus\-scale developments, high\-density AI infrastructure, and liquid cooling implementations
* Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
* Professional development opportunities including training, industry conferences, and certifications

Meydan Free Zone offers entrepreneurs and start\-up businesses the opportunity to set up and run their own businesses right in the heart of Dubai. We provide access to exceptional talent, entrepreneur expertise, and a wide range of start\-up support services.
 



  





 As we continue our exciting growth plans, we seek talented people to join us. We are currently hiring a dynamic
 **Assistant Manager \- Client Servicing**

This role focuses on driving operational efficiency, ensuring regulatory compliance, improving service delivery, and building team capability through structured training and performance monitoring. The ideal candidate is an Arabic speaker with a proven track record of optimizing processes through data\-driven reporting and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




**Operations Management** 



* Support end\-to\-end operations for business licensing and UAE residence visa processing (GDRFA), ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with Free Zone and government regulations.
* Monitor daily workloads, case progress, SLAs, and turnaround times; proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with internal departments and external stakeholders, if needed (GDRFA, Free Zone authorities, typing centers, medical/Emirates ID partners, Third Party Authorities) to ensure smooth processing.



  





**Process Improvement \& Efficiency** 



* Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives using Six Sigma/Lean methodologies to enhance efficiency, reduce errors, and improve customer experience.
* Document, review, and standardize SOPs, workflows, and checklists across licensing and visa operations.
* Track KPIs and operational metrics; recommend corrective actions based on trend analysis and root cause findings.



  





**Reporting \& Analytics** 



* Prepare accurate and timely operational reports (daily/weekly/monthly) covering volumes, TAT, compliance, rework rates, and productivity to support management decision\-making and capacity planning.



  





**Training \& People Development** 



* Design and deliver structured onboarding and refresher training programs for operations staff.
* Conduct process briefings, quality clinics, and coaching sessions to uplift team capability and consistency.
* Support performance reviews by providing feedback and improvement plans.

* Ensure adherence to Free Zone regulations, Third\-Party Authorities, GDRFA requirements, and internal policies.

**Customer Experience** 



* Support escalation handling and resolution of complex cases to ensure high customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with sales and customer service teams to align expectations, documentation requirements, and timelines.

* Bachelor’s degree required in an education\-related field or Business Administration, or relevant experience within a legal\-related company or industry (e.g., Education, Training, Instructional Design, Educational Management, Business Administration, Law, Legal Studies, or similar).

* Demonstrated track record of driving operational efficiency, process optimization, and measurable performance improvements.
* Experience in reporting, data analysis, and performance management.
* Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher preferred).
* Experience in call center or contact center operations/management is a strong advantage, particularly in high\-volume, SLA\-driven environments.
* Strong understanding of UAE business licensing and residence visa processes (GDRFA experience is a strong advantage).
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Strong reporting and presentation skills; ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Training and facilitation skills; comfortable delivering structured learning sessions.
* High attention to detail and strong compliance orientation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, regulated environment.



  





**Language skills:** 



* English.
* Any other language is desirable.

📌 𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗰𝗿𝗶𝗽𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻:
   

  

 A client of byteSpark.ai is seeking a Head of AI\-Assisted Engineering to join a forward\-thinking bank based in Dubai, in a role that is as much about building a new way of working as it is about delivering software. The context is deliberate and worth stating plainly: this bank currently runs an offshore engineering team of 35 and is bringing that function back onshore to Dubai as a lean team of 8, with AI\-assisted development tools as the engine that makes that ratio not just viable but genuinely more powerful. The person hired into this role will report directly to the CEO, own the build of this centre of excellence from the ground up, and be accountable for delivering across mobile and web banking applications, internal tooling, and compliance and governance platforms. The right candidate will have strong engineering leadership credentials in a regulated environment, a hands\-on and current working knowledge of tools like Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, and the maturity to operate with significant autonomy at the most senior level of the organisation. This role will not suit someone who has read about AI\-assisted engineering. It is built for someone who has already changed how they work because of it and is ready to build a team and a practice around that shift.

 Check out more about

 CFI is hiring! Make your mark in the online trading industry.
 



 Are you looking to pursue a career in finance? Do you want to work with a dynamic and growing team in the exciting world of online trading and investing? If you answered yes, then we have some amazing opportunities for you!
 



  





**Description:** 




 We’re seeking a Head of Security to lead and develop our cybersecurity function as an independent structure reporting directly to the CEO. This role requires a unique blend of offensive security expertise, hands\-on engineering background, and the ability to implement pragmatic security controls that guard rather than block business velocity. You’ll work closely with the CTO and technology teams to build security into our delivery pipeline while preparing the organization for regulatory compliance in financial services.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Build security frameworks based on ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, and SOC 2, Ensure compliance with DORA, EBA Guidelines, ISO 27001
* Implement information security governance structure, policies, and risk management processes
* Establish and maintain security metrics, KPIs, and reporting for executive leadership
* Secure Perimeter \& Infrastructure Protection \-Design and implement network segmentation and secure perimeter architecture
* Collaborate with development teams to establish secure SDLC practices: Integrate security into CI/CD pipelines with automated quality gates (SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning, aplication security tools)
* Conduct penetration testing and API security assesments using Kali Linux, Metasploit, Burp Suite, and other offensive security tools
* Provide hands\-on remediation guidance that developers can implement



  





**Requirements:** 



* Required Certifications (minimum 2\):



 Offensive Security ( OSCP, OSCE, GPEN, or CEH), Security Management (CISSP or CISM),
 



 Cloud Security (CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, or Azure Security Engineer), Audit (CISA)
 


* 8\+ years in information security roles
* 3\+ years in security leadership positions
* Mandatory: Experience in regulated financial services (banking, brokerage, payments, fintech)
* Hands\-on penetration testing and vulnerability assessment experience
* Development or DevOps background with practical coding experience
* Successfully implemented DevSecOps practices and security automation
* Experience with regulatory audits and compliance assessments



**Required Technical Skills:** 



* Offensive security tools: Kali Linux, Metasploit, Burp Suite, Nmap, Wireshark, SQLMap
* Programming: Proficient in Python (prefferable) or atl least one other language
* Scripting: Mandatory proficiency in Bash, Zsh, and PowerShell
* Pragmatic security mindset: Balance security with business enablement
* Collaborative leadership: Build trust with engineering teams
* Strong communication: Translate security risks into business impact



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience with trading platforms, payment systems, or financial infrastructure
* Knowledge of AI/ML/LLM security considerations
* Familiarity with MT5, trading APIs, payment processing systems



  





**Why join CFI?** 




 · We’re a fast\-growing, multinational company
 



 · Competitive salaries and benefits
 



 · Work and learn with industry professions
 



 · Supportive and collaborative environment
 



 · Unlimited opportunities for growth and development

**Overview**
 This Senior Investment Advisor position is based in Dubai, UAE, and sits within the investment advisory function of a major regional bank operating across the MENAT region. The role reports to the Team Head of Investment Advisory and carries full responsibility for the delivery of investment advice to ultra\-high\-net\-worth clients. It combines a senior client\-facing mandate with internal team oversight, requiring close collaboration with Relationship Managers and direct engagement with key clients.

* Oversee team performance and development by driving revenue targets, maintaining quality standards, tracking budgets, and supporting the continuous development of team members.
* Liaise directly with key clients and Relationship Managers to ensure alignment between client objectives and investment strategy.


**Skills \& Experience**
* A minimum of seven years of financial experience, including at least five years in investment\-related roles.
* Three or more years of Private Banking experience with a strong investment focus is preferred.
* In\-depth knowledge of investment products, services, fee structures, legal provisions, and delivery processes.
* Strong understanding of equity and bond markets, unit trusts, and personal investment services, with the ability to apply this knowledge to business planning.
* Solid grasp of investment theory with the ability to provide both tactical and operational investment solutions.
* Familiarity with securities dealing and foreign exchange trade procedures.
* Demonstrated experience managing or developing a team.
* Proficiency in Arabic is required.

data.jd_text:
**About RG Group** 


 RG Group is a Dubai\-based real estate investment and business consultation advisory firm. We are launching a dedicated Brand Consultation division to help retail brands and businesses establish, grow, and expand across the UAE — combining strategic brand advisory with direct access to leasing opportunities and prime retail space.
 




  




**Role Summary** 


 The Business Development Executive is the primary revenue driver for the department. This role is responsible for identifying, approaching, and converting retail brands and business owners who need help expanding in the UAE market — whether through brand strategy consultation, retail space leasing, or both. You will build and manage a pipeline of prospective clients, pitch RG Group's consultation services, and close signed mandates that combine advisory fees with leasing transactions.
 





 This is a hunter role suited to someone who is energized by targets, comfortable with cold outreach, and confident pitching to business owners and decision\-makers across UAE retail and F\&B sectors.
 




  




**Key Responsibilities** 

**Client Acquisition \& Pipeline Development** 



* Identify and approach retail brands, F\&B businesses, and SMEs looking to launch or expand in the UAE.
* Build a consistent pipeline of qualified leads through cold calling, networking, referrals, and digital outreach.
* Attend industry trade shows, exhibitions, and networking events (e.g. Gulfood, Beautyworld, Cityscape) to generate new business.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of all leads and client interactions in the CRM system.



**Sales \& Client Conversion** 



* Present RG Group's brand consultation and leasing services to prospective clients, clearly articulating value and differentiation.
* Coordinate with the Head of Brand Consultation and Brand Strategy Consultant to prepare tailored proposals for each prospect.
* Negotiate consultation retainers, advisory fees, and introduce leasing opportunities where relevant.
* Close signed mandates and hand over client relationships smoothly to the delivery team for onboarding.



**Cross\-Department Coordination** 



* Work closely with the Retail Leasing Coordinator to match client requirements with available retail spaces in RG Group's portfolio and partner network.
* Liaise with the Brand Strategy Consultant to ensure sales commitments are realistic and deliverable.
* Provide market feedback to leadership on client needs, objections, and competitor activity.



**Reporting \& Targets** 



* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets as agreed with the Head of Brand Consultation.
* Prepare regular pipeline and conversion reports for management review.



  




**Required Experience \& Qualifications** 
* 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or account management, ideally within real estate, retail, hospitality, or professional advisory services.
* Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* Strong existing network or familiarity with UAE retail, F\&B, or franchise business communities is a strong advantage.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred, though strong sales track record may substitute for formal qualification.
* Valid UAE driving license preferred, given travel to client meetings and site visits across the Emirates.


**Key Skills \& Attributes** 
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; Arabic language skills are a strong advantage.
* Confident, persuasive presenter who is comfortable engaging with business owners and senior decision\-makers.
* Self\-motivated “hunter” mentality — comfortable with cold outreach and proactive prospecting.
* Resilient under rejection and consistent in pipeline\-building activity.
* Strong organizational skills with comfort using CRM tools to manage leads and follow\-ups.
* Basic understanding of retail leasing concepts and UAE business setup is an advantage, though training will be provided.


**Compensation \& Benefits** 
* **Basic salary: AED 8,000 – 10,000 per month, based on experience.**
* **Uncapped commission structure: 2–4% of consulting fees and leasing\-related revenue generated, paid on successful client conversion.**
* On\-target earnings (OTE) realistically range from AED 11,000 – 16,000 per month for a consistent performer.
* Standard UAE employment benefits: medical insurance, annual leave, and end\-of\-service gratuity as per UAE Labour Law.
* Visa sponsorship provided by RG Group.
* Clear path for career growth into a Business Development Manager or Senior Consultant role as the department scales.


**Success Indicators (First 6 Months)** 
* Build and maintain a qualified pipeline of at least 15–20 active prospects per month.
* Close a minimum of 3–5 signed client mandates within the first two quarters.
* Establish at least one repeatable lead\-generation channel (e.g. event circuit, referral network, or digital outreach).

data.jd_text:
**Who We Are**
 VML, part of WPP, is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and human first, award\-winning work for blue chip client partners including AstraZeneca, Colgate\-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca\-Cola Company, and Wendy's. The agency is recognized by the Forrester Wave™ Reports, as a Leader among Marketing Creative and Content Service Providers, Commerce Services, Global Digital Experience Services, Global Marketing Services and, most recently, Marketing Measurement \& Optimization. In addition, VML’s specialist health network, VML Health, is one of the world’s largest and most awarded health agencies. VML’s global network is powered by 26,000 talented people across 55\+ markets, with principal offices in Kansas City, New York, Detroit, London, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Sydney.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

**Senior Digital Analyst**
**Agency:** 
 VML MENA
   

  

**Practice:** 
 Data \& CRM
   

  

**Sector Focus:** 
 Financial Services / Banking
   

  

**Level:** 
 Senior (7–10 years’ experience)
   

  

**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE (with collaborative alignment across regional teams, including Beirut)
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Head of Data \& CRM
   

  

**About VML**
 At VML, we harness the power of connection to build outstanding brand experiences. We combine brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to drive growth for some of the world’s most prestigious global and regional brands.
   

  

**The Role**
 This is a senior analytics leadership hire within VML MENA's Data \& CRM practice.
   

  

 You will own the digital analytics capability across web and CRM for one of the agency’s largest financial services (FS) clients. In this role, you will set the analytical agenda, deliver insights that drive critical business decisions, support and develop a small team of analysts, and champion high\-quality analytics across the agency.
   

  

 You are as comfortable working directly with and presenting to clients as you are with designing, developing, and executing analytics strategies. Alongside this, you will support the Head of Data \& CRM in business growth and development, helping the team deliver on broader client projects that extend the scope of our work.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Analytics Leadership
* Define Digital Measurement Strategy: Shape and lead the digital measurement strategy across web and CRM channels for our key financial services client.
* GA4 360 \& GTM Governance: Own implementation standards, including tagging schemas, data layer design, data quality verification, and QA protocols.
* Data Storytelling: Translate complex data sets and technical metrics into clear, persuasive narratives for senior client stakeholders and C\-suite executives.
* Set the Analytical Agenda: Partner with the Head of Data \& CRM to identify critical business questions, designing the technical and analytical solutions required to answer them.
* Delivery \& Execution
* Funnel Analysis: Lead deep\-dive analyses of customer acquisition, engagement, conversion, and retention across digital and CRM channels.
* Dashboard Development: Build and maintain interactive, high\-impact dashboards in PowerBI and Looker Studio to inform daily and strategic decision\-making.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Configure, debug, and optimize GTM, MS Clarity/Hotjar (for UX and behavioral analysis), and AppsFlyer/Adjust (for mobile app attribution) as required.
* A/B Testing \& Experimentation: Design, execute, and interpret A/B and multivariate tests with statistical rigor.
* AI \& Innovation
* Deploy AI Agents: Build and deploy AI agents that query, analyze, and visualize data, cutting time\-to\-insight across the practice.
* Stay Ahead of Tech: Actively track emerging analytics tools and methods, introducing them when they improve what clients can see, measure, or decide.
* Raise the Analytics Bar: Elevate capability internally and with client teams through structured documentation, hands\-on training, and by asking sharper, more strategic questions.
* People \& Clients
* Team Mentorship: Manage and mentor a small team of analysts—setting performance standards, reviewing deliverables, and supporting their professional growth.
* Senior Point of Contact: Act as the lead analytics voice in client meetings, workshops, and strategic reviews.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with CRM, strategy, and technology leads to ensure robust measurement is built into digital programs from the very beginning, rather than bolted on at the end.


**Technology \& Tools**
* Web \& App Analytics: GA4 360 (required), GTM
* UX Intelligence: Microsoft Clarity and/or Hotjar
* Mobile Attribution: AppsFlyer and/or Adjust
* Visualization: PowerBI, Looker Studio
* AI \& Automation: Demonstrated experience building AI agents for data querying, analysis, and visualization


**Essential Experience**
**What We're Looking For**
* 7–10 years of experience in digital analytics, with at least 3 years in a senior capacity.
* Hands\-on GA4 360 expertise: Strong background in implementation, debugging, governance, and reporting.
* Industry Focus: Proven experience in financial services or banking (either agency or client\-side).
* Commercial Instinct: An innate ability to connect granular analytical findings to high\-level business and commercial outcomes.
* Communication: A clear, direct communicator who can simplify complex technical data.
* Leadership: Demonstrated experience managing or mentoring junior analysts.
* Stakeholder Management: Comfortable in client\-facing settings, including presenting to senior marketing directors and C\-suite stakeholders.


**Highly Desirable**
* Experience building AI agents or LLM\-powered tools for data analysis workflows.
* SQL proficiency for working with BigQuery or similar cloud data warehouse environments.
* CRM analytics experience (lifecycle marketing, customer retention, and campaign performance).
* Familiarity with statistical testing: confidence intervals, significance testing, and knowing when not to over\-interpret data.
* Prior advertising or digital agency experience managing multiple client relationships simultaneously.


**The Kind of Person You Are**
* Curious: You care about what the data actually says, even when it contradicts the brief or initial assumptions.
* Versatile: You are as comfortable running a strategic client workshop as you are writing a technical query.
* Inventive: You actively look for creative ways to solve problems and tackle challenges that haven't been solved before.
* Quality\-Driven: You hold exceptionally high standards, but possess the pragmatism to know when to bend them.
* Enabling: You make the analysts around you better through mentorship, collaborative teaching, and leading by example.


 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

 WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

 Leadership Role: Yes

 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary. **Process Safety Management Specialist / Senior PSE** 




 The Process Safety Management (PSM) Specialist reports to the Head of Health \& Safety and supports the effective implementation of process safety management across the Generation International (GI) fleet.
 



 Working closely with the Process Safety manager, this role focuses on supporting the development of local PSM champions, coordinating process safety network activities, and facilitating hazard identification and risk analysis to help mitigate risks across assets. The role will contribute to training delivery, performance monitoring, incident investigations, and sharing lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.
 



 The position is based in Dubai, with frequent travel across the GI perimeter, including GCC, KSA, Africa, Chile, Peru, Mexico, Canada, and Australia to support site activities.
 



  





**Role Details** 



* **Reporting to:** 
 Head of Health and Safety, Generation International
* **Location:** 
 Dubai
* **Travel:** 
 \~70% across international sites
* **Employment Type:** 
 Permanent, Full\-Time



  





**Key Activities and Responsibilities** 




**Strategic** 



* Support the implementation and enhancement of process safety management practices across the GI fleet
* Contribute to the development of the fleet risk profile and support mitigation action tracking
* Assist in promoting process safety awareness across regions, countries, and asset teams
* Share process safety knowledge and lessons learned across the organization
* Encourage collaboration and knowledge exchange between sites and business units



  





**Operational** 



* Support compliance with Engie Group Rules, standards, and procedures (including GR09 H\&S in Industrial Projects and GEN PSM Fundamentals)

* Participate in or support Process Hazard Risk Assessments (PHRA), including BowTie workshops and reviews
* Assist with tracking and close\-out of actions arising from risk assessments and audits
* Support implementation of hazard identification and risk assessment processes, including Safety Critical Elements (SCEs)
* Participate in safety reviews (HAZID, HAZOP, audits, inspections) across O\&M and project sites
* Support project teams in meeting process safety requirements throughout the project lifecycle
* Maintain and update process safety documentation to ensure accuracy and alignment with site conditions
* Contribute to incident investigations and root cause analysis (e.g., TapRoot methodology)
* Ensure timely reporting of Process Safety Events (PSEs) in the One Safety Tool (OST)



  





**Organisational** 



* Support the development and rollout of PSM training programs and materials
* Contribute to competency development of site teams and PSM champions
* Assist in setting and tracking process safety objectives and KPIs



  





**Planning \& Performance Monitoring** 



* Support the maintenance of process safety dashboards and KPIs
* Monitor process safety performance and highlight trends or areas for improvement
* Assist in identifying and tracking corrective and preventive actions



  





**Decision Making** 



* Provide input into project safety reviews and derogation requests
* Participate in investigation teams for process safety events
* Escalate key risks and support mitigation planning



  





**Collaboration** 



* Work closely with asset PSM champions and support their development
* Collaborate with Industrial Projects H\&S teams and site management
* Promote sharing of process safety knowledge across all levels of the organization



  





**Leadership \& Contribution** 



* Act as a key contributor to process safety initiatives within GI

* Contribute to a strong process safety culture across the organization



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Education** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or a related field
* NEBOSH Certificate in Process Safety Management (or equivalent) preferred



  





**Experience** 



* **6–8 years’ experience** 
 in process safety, industrial safety, or related fields
* Experience in power generation, energy, or industrial environments is advantageous
* Exposure to hazard analysis techniques (e.g., HAZOP, BowTie) preferred



  





**Knowledge \& Skills** 



* Understanding of industrial processes and associated risks
* Familiarity with process safety management systems and standards
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities
* Good communication skills with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders
* Ability to support training delivery and knowledge sharing
* Basic incident investigation and root cause analysis skills
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across geographies
